verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a single partitioning API that handles "65+ file types" and returns them in a "consistent JSON format". It also auto-routes each page to a partitioning strategy, which covers the core idea of one API with no per-format plumbing. Only PDFs, forms and scans are named, so the specific formats in the story are not confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML and email support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.

support.subject: As a developer, one API handles my whole document mix — PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, email — without per-format plumbing

citations.quote: Discover hidden insights with 35+ connectors and 65+ file types. Consistent JSON format. All-in-one data layer.
Support for 65+ File Types. Parse PDFs, tables, forms and scans into structured data your agents can trust.

_Partitioning_ converts content from unstructured files and semi-structured data records into structured [document elements and metadata](/concepts/document-elements) in a predefined, consistent, expressive, and contextualized JSON format.
Auto evaluates each page and routes it to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning, balancing quality, speed, and cost.
